title: Make Completed size column switchable
summary: Adds a read-only Completed table display toggle so the existing Size column can show either size delta/bytes or bitrate evidence without adding another column.
reason: The size and bitrate evidence are useful, but showing both as separate columns would overcrowd the Completed output tables.
behavior_before: Completed current/history tables always displayed size delta/output size in the Size column, with no compact way to view route bitrate evidence there.
behavior_after: Completed current/history tables keep one numeric evidence column and let the operator switch it between Size and Bitrate. Bitrate values are display-only evidence from completed manifest route metadata when available.
